name: listing-disclosures
description: Check a US sale/rental lead-disclosure packet against property age, exemptions, available records, timing, electronic consent and signed-record retention. Use when reviewing pasted disclosure forms, property facts, available-report indexes, consent terms or execution logs before signing, or auditing signed copies after a sale or lease begins. Get case-specific missing-document, field and timing corrections and federal minimum retention dates. Works without accounts or connectors. Not for public listing copy, renovation practices, paint testing or general contract drafting.
